Location.title: Location
Location.description: A physical inventory holding site — warehouse, distribution center, retail store, or other storage location. Foundation for multi-location stock tracking per REQ-IST-005. Declared in shillinq pending budget-planning-control spec landing.

name.description: Human-readable location name recognizable to warehouse operators.

code.description: Short operator-assigned location code. Unique per (organizationId, code).

description.description: Optional description of the location's purpose or characteristics.
description.example: Head office distribution center — serves NL and BE markets

address.description: Full postal address of the location.

region.description: City or regional grouping for reporting aggregations.

locationType.description: Kind of location: warehouse, store, distribution_center, depot, or other.

capacityUnits.description: Maximum stock capacity in units. Informational; enforcement is downstream.

manager.description: Name or ID of the location manager.

status.description: Location lifecycle status. active = in use; inactive = closed or out of service.

organizationId.description: FK to the organization owning this location. Combined with code forms the uniqueness key.

InventoryStock.title: Inventory Stock
InventoryStock.description: Stock quantity snapshot per (product, location). Tracks on-hand, reserved, in-transit, and available quantities for multi-warehouse inventory management per REQ-IST-001 through REQ-IST-013. Foundation for downstream StockMove, reorder automation, and COGS posting specs.

product.description: FK to Product register (from inventory-product-catalog). Required per REQ-IST-004. Uniqueness constraint on (product, location, organizationId).

location.description: FK to Location entity. Required per REQ-IST-005. Represents warehouse, distribution center, store, or other holding site.

quantityOnHand.description: Physical quantity currently in the location per REQ-IST-002. Supports fractional units (0.5L, 2.25kg). Default 0.00.

quantityReserved.description: Quantity allocated to pending orders, production plans, or shipments. Not available for new allocations per REQ-IST-002. Default 0.00.

quantityInTransit.description: Quantity en route from supplier or between locations. Not yet received; not in on-hand count per REQ-IST-003. Default 0.00.

quantityAvailable.description: Computed read-only field: quantityOnHand minus quantityReserved per REQ-IST-008. Never stored; recalculated on every retrieval.

unitCost.description: Standard or average cost per unit at time of last receipt per REQ-IST-006. Used for P&L (COGS) and balance sheet valuation. Currency matches Product.currency.

lastRestockDate.description: Timestamp of the most recent stock receipt or manual adjustment per REQ-IST-012. Supports aging queries and replenishment planning.

status.description: Stock record status. Mirrors Product.status for query efficiency per REQ-IST-011. active = in normal use; discontinued = product phased out.

organizationId.description: FK to the organization owning this stock record. Multi-tenancy scoping per REQ-IST-007. Combined with product+location forms the uniqueness key.

quantityAvailable.description: Derived available-to-promise quantity: on-hand minus reserved per REQ-IST-008. Recalculated on every read; not stored in the database.

productRecord.description: The product this stock record tracks. FK to Product register per REQ-IST-004.

locationRecord.description: The physical location where this stock is held. FK to Location per REQ-IST-005.
